metadata.title: Villa Vicuña | Salta, Argentina
metadata.description: Boutique hotel in the heart of Salta city, steps from the historic center. 12 Spanish colonial-style rooms and personalized service.

hero.subtitulo: Discover the unique experience at our boutique hotel.

about_us.parrafo1: On the historic 'Corredor de la Fe', a few meters from the Cathedral, rises the Boutique Hotel Villa Vicuña, a house from the early 19th century adapted according to its style and inspired by a novel by the writer Isabel Allende.
about_us.parrafo2: A unique place with an exquisite touch in timeless details makes the stay unforgettable.
about_us.parrafo3: Among corridors, balconies, and palm trees, the 12 rooms that precede the garden open up, a small oasis in the middle of the city where time seems to stand still.

reseñas.descripcion: At Villa Vicuña our guests are the main engine that drives the constant work to achieve excellence in quality and services, it is their reviews that we treasure as a source of inspiration.

desayuno.texto:
At Villa Vicuña we understand the importance of a complete, healthy breakfast with fresh seasonal products made at home. 

On our menu you will find a selection of five dishes with different flavors and textures suggested by the chef, in addition to the buffet with other homemade delicacies. 

We put our menus at your disposal that can be consulted when you like to enjoy our flavors during your stay.
reseñas: « -¨...Exquisite breakfast! The variety of dishes and the room are spectacular, beautiful decoration...¨»
« -¨...A pleasure to enjoy such a delicious breakfast under the bougainvillea, we felt very pampered by the warmth of the service, I’m sure we’ll return¨»
« -¨...And the breakfast is very complete, everything is delicious, the mini bar in the room was very pleasant, thank you, we hope to return soon.¨»

detalles.texto: Because they surround us, disconnect us and transport us to other times, at Villa Vicuña we give special attention to details, creating corners for unforgettable moments.
reseñas: « -¨Wonderful hotel, such delicate decoration, the choice of colors, everything is perfect...¨»
« -¨Magnificent hotel with a refined style, ideal location to discover Salta. Thank you for the warm welcome¨»
« -¨What a great atmosphere, I really enjoyed the warmth of the fire when it was cold, excellent location to explore the mountains and the city.¨»

personal.texto: Our team...our family, responsible for the excellent warmth and quality of our services, with their dedication and kindness make our guests feel at home.
reseñas: « -¨...The staff was exceptionally kind, especially at reception, who did the impossible to help us — charming, attentive, smiling, very kind...¨»
« -¨...Beautiful memories, forever in my heart — beauty, attention, and affection. Thank you and I hope this is not the last trip.¨»
« -¨What a beautiful hotel, what a discovery!!! I will tell others... Thank you for the wonderful service, keep it up!!¨»

menu.descripcion: Discover the exclusive flavors of Villa Vicuña. A unique combination of local ingredients and traditional recipes.

twin_interna.descripcion: With spectacular dimensions characteristic of past centuries, this magnificent room tells its story through boiserie, pinewood flooring, and double-height shutters. Two Twin beds complement the atmosphere as if from another era, and the window faces the internal corridor.
twin_interna.parrafo_minibar: Among the Amenities you will find an unloaded Mini Bar from which you can serve an infusion while you rest.

matrimonial.descripcion: Facing the palm-lined corridor, on the first floor accessible by stairs, this beautiful 26m² room is located. Its splendid matrimonial bed rests on the characteristic hydraulic tiles that define our hotel.
matrimonial.parrafo_minibar: Among the Amenities you will find an unloaded Mini Bar from which you can serve an infusion while you rest.

triple.descripcion: Facing the palm-lined corridor, on the ground floor, our 26m² Triple Standard room features two beds—a double and a single—resting on the characteristic hydraulic tiles that define our hotel.
triple.parrafo_minibar: Among the Amenities you will find an unloaded Mini Bar from which you can serve an infusion while you rest.

balcon.descripcion: At the end of the corridor on the first floor, accessible by stairs, this beautiful 26m² room overlooks the garden. A canopy bed rests on the characteristic hydraulic tiles that define our hotel.
balcon.parrafo_minibar: Among the Amenities you will find an unloaded Mini Bar from which you can serve an infusion while you rest.

jardin.descripcion: At the end of the corridor on the ground floor, in what we call our 'Green Wing,' this beautiful 26m² room borders the garden. A spacious bed rests on the characteristic hydraulic tiles that define our hotel.
jardin.parrafo_minibar: Among the Amenities you will find an unloaded Mini Bar from which you can serve an infusion while you rest.

salta.titulo: What to do in Salta Capital during your stay
salta.descripcion: This guide brings together places, walks, and experiences inside Salta Capital. The focus is on real options, close to the center and useful for guests staying at Villa Vicuña.

experiences.titulo: High-altitude wines, told from the inside
experiences.descripcion: Together with Barolo, a high-altitude wine tasting hosted by its winemaker, Luci Chávez Díaz, on site at the hotel. Intimate and exclusive to our guests.
experiences.descripcion2: Each session invites you to understand, through wine, the land that shapes it: Salta's altitude, soils and climate.
experiences.quote: I don't want you to taste a wine. I want you to understand why that wine could only be born here, in this vineyard, at this altitude.
experiences.formatosDescripcion: Every story shares the same warmth and intimacy. What sets them apart is the journey each selection proposes.
experiences.whatsappMensaje: Hello! I’m interested in the «{experiencia}» Barolo experience at Villa Vicuña. Could you send me more information?

intima.resumen: One label, one territory, one story told slowly. The wine as the absolute protagonist: an iconic Salta label, its history and its place of origin.

terroir.resumen: Three labels, three versions of what altitude means. A journey through different Salta terroirs that reveals the diversity behind the idea of altitude.

atardecer.resumen: In the most private corner of the hotel, timed to meet the Salta sunset. High-end wines and a food pairing curated to measure for each encounter.
incluye: A corner of the hotel reserved just for you

experiences.tapeoDescripcion: Crafted to converse with the wine served, never to overshadow it.
tapeo: Stuffed dates wrapped in cured ham
experiences.testimonioTexto: Every wine has a story... I'm Luci Chávez Díaz, winemaker and curator of Barolo. Together with Villa Vicuña, we've created a special moment for their guests: a curated selection to discover the wines of northern Argentina. I invite you to explore the stories, landscapes, and producers that express our region's identity, glass by glass. More than a tasting, it's an intimate encounter to connect with our culture and discover Salta from its origins. Join us at Barolo, inside Villa Vicuña.
experiences.reservaTexto: At least 24 hours in advance at the front desk, subject to availability.
experiences.idiomaTexto: Hosted in Spanish or English, as you prefer.
experiences.botellaTexto: The label you tasted can be purchased to take with you.
experiences.ctaTexto: Ask at the front desk for full details on the Barolo experience, available formats, and how it can be tailored to your stay. An experience exclusive to Villa Vicuña guests.
